**TL;DR**

# **VSR STRAT RULES** 
*(Play Smart or Get Banned, Bitch)*

**1. No cheating / hacking** – Don’t be that clown.

**2. No hoverkilling Recycler** – Stop cheesing from the sky, asshole.

**3. Don’t kill pilots on Rec Pad – Except:**
*• Enemy pilots can kill pad campers.

• AI kills don’t count if game-ending.

• Suspected snipers? Shoot those bastards.*

**4. Don’t kill AI meant for players** – Scouts/Tanks are off-limits.

*• Sniping is okay.

• Outside base? Fair game.*

**5. No blowing up empty Scouts on Rec Pad** – You can steal ‘em, but your old ride becomes the new “empty,” and it’s safe till used.

**6. No “stuff in stuff” bullshit –**
*• No hiding units in buildings to cheese.

• No parking vehicles inside enemy structures to pew-pew.*

**7. Leave first 2 enemy Scavs alone in base** – Let ‘em live till they’re out.

**8. No early Recycler rush** – Win first fight ≠ free rec kill.

*• Unless the enemy rec is outside normal base area.*

**9. No game-throwing** – Don’t tank games on purpose.

*• Exception: If enemies drag shit forever, commander can self-nuke rec/fac to end.*

**10. No base camping** – Don’t sit there spawn-killing fresh builds.

*• Already inside base blowing shit up? Okay to smash what pops out.*

# **VSR STRATS FOR DUMBASSES**


**1. LISTEN TO YOUR FUCKING COMMANDER**
He’s the boss. If everyone does their own shit, you get chaos, not victory. Read chat, obey orders, don’t be a lone wolf moron.

**2. WATCH YOUR DAMN RADAR (R KEY, USE IT)**
Radar saves lives, dipshit. If you ain’t looking, you’re basically begging to get fucked in the ass by a sneak attack. Smash that T key like it owes you money.

**3. READ CHAT, YOU ILLITERATE FUCK**
Chat = survival. Miss a “DON’T GO THERE” and boom, you’re dead. Team falls apart, all ‘cause you were daydreaming.

**4. DON’T BE A SOLO HERO**
Stick with the squad. Lone dots on radar = free kill. You’re not Rambo, you’re just extra scrap.

**5. PAINT SHIT, CONSTANTLY**
Hit F11, tag enemies, scream “PAINT BACK” if you need. No paint = blind dumb team. Always paint the big scary bastard first.

**6. COMMUNICATE OR DIE QUIETLY**
Enemy upgrades? Scrap incoming? Red Field tank? FUCKING SAY IT. Silence = useless teammate.

**7. DON’T DIE NEAR ENEMY BASE**
Congrats, dumbass, you just gift-wrapped free scrap for the enemy. Don’t.

**8. FIGHT SMART, NOT LIKE A DRUNK IDIOT**
Don’t chase unless you’re 100% sure. Don’t fight uphill like a donkey. Don’t waste time shooting hover dudes if you can’t reach them. Think before you YOLO.

**9. USE COMMON SENSE** (LOL, GOOD LUCK)
Isolated enemy? Jump him. Outnumbered? Smash him. Strongest thug? Kill first. Don’t assume enemies are stupid — assume they’re behind you already.

Literally THE most fun I've EVER had commanding. AND it was while Scion.

Full disclosure though this was supposed to be a meme game so idk if lith was just trolling or not. Definitely not a stat worthy game but it was FUCKING AWESOME.
